# find_smiles_in_mofid { #mofography.analyze.find_smiles_in_mofid }

```python
analyze.find_smiles_in_mofid(mofid, pattern_smiles)
```

Search MOFid linker SMILES segments for matches to a SMILES pattern via ``detect_smiles_in_mol``.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name           | Type   | Description                                                       | Default    |
|----------------|--------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| mofid          |        | the MOFid string                                                  | _required_ |
| pattern_smiles |        | a list of SMILES strings that you want to search for in the MOFid | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                         |
|--------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | A list of lists of the patterns found in the MOFid. |
